slice: response-bound GitHub API version evidence verifier
finding: A static supported-version allowlist does not prove that an actual enumeration request sent the intended X-GitHub-Api-Version header or that GitHub accepted the version without deprecation, sunset, or 410 Gone signals.
falsification_route: A request without an explicit X-GitHub-Api-Version header is promoted.
A configured version that differs from the transmitted header is promoted.
A response carrying Deprecation or Sunset headers is promoted.
A non-2xx workflow enumeration response is promoted.
limits: No authenticated private-repository response headers were retained in this slice.
next_action: Compose this verifier into the integrated workflow enumeration gate and retain exact request headers, response status, Deprecation, and Sunset headers for both exhaustive clients.
